items.source: Wrapper annotation to allow QueryHint annotations to be bound to methods. It will be evaluated when using Query on a query method or if you derive the query from the method name. If you rely on named queries either use the XML or annotation based way to declare QueryHints in combination with the actual named query declaration.
items.translation: 这是一个包装注解，允许将 `QueryHint` 注解绑定到方法上。当在查询方法上使用Query注解，或者从方法名推导查询时，该注解将被评估。如果您依赖命名查询，请使用 XML 或基于注解的方式声明 `QueryHint`，并将其与实际的命名查询声明结合使用。

items.source: Defines whether the configured QueryHints shall be applied for count queries during pagination as well.
items.translation: 同时定义在分页期间对计数查询是否应用配置的 `QueryHint`。

items.source: Defines whether the configured QueryHints shall be applied for count queries during pagination as well. Defaults to true.
items.translation: 定义在分页期间是否也将配置的 QueryHint 应用于计数查询。默认值为 true。
